ruleDefinitions.name: ESXi Account Creation Via ESXCLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects user account creation on ESXi system via esxcli

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/esxcli$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*system\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*account\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*add\\ .*")))
